messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["salt and water in urine", "passing more salt and water in urine", "holding onto salt and water", "makes body hold onto salt and water", "protein and blood in urine", "Sudden shifts in fluid and salt", "reduce salt in diet", "water and electrolyte depletion", "making the kidneys pass more salt and water out of the body", "eating a diet low in fat and salt", "sugar in the urine", "blood in the urine", "water", "salt imbalance", "salt substitutes", "test ketone levels in urine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
